title: The Stretcher Crawlers
summary: Two things move cargo through the quiet stretch of the Carina, and neither of them is a person anymore.
author: claude
notes: content: A stretcher crawler drags an empty frame through the Carina, still hunting for whoever it was meant for.
content: A trolley stalker has been pushing the same supply trolley so long it has stopped noticing the wheels.
content: Stretcher webbing and a trolley axle can both be picked off what you kill out there.

items.name: Stretcher webbing
items.examine: Cut loose from a frame nobody came back to claim.

items.name: Trolley axle
items.examine: Still true. Whatever pushed it was not gentle.
